reviews.body:
Thanks for the contribution, and for the clear write-up and regression test!

The fix looks right. The subscription and item IDs are stored correctly everywhere they're written; only this v1 mapper had them swapped. I checked that the new test fails against the old mapper and passes with the fix.

Before we can merge, please sign the [Contributor License Agreement](https://cla-assistant.io/openmeterio/openmeter?pullRequest=5464). The `license/cla` check is still pending.

Two small requests inline:
- mention in the PR description that `invoice.*` webhook payloads change too, not only the API response
- move the test to `invoiceline_test.go`

The failing OpenAPI codegen and release note label checks aren't caused by this change, so there's nothing to do there.

review_comments.body:
This mapper also builds the payload for `invoice.*` webhooks (through `MapEventInvoiceToAPI` in the notification consumer), so the fix changes webhook payloads as well as API responses. Payloads are stored when the event is created, and resends replay the stored copy. Events from before this change will keep the swapped IDs under the same payload version.

Could you add a short note to the PR description saying that both the invoice API response and `invoice.*` webhook payloads change, and that anyone who worked around the swap should remove the workaround? We'll decide on our side whether it also needs the breaking-change label.
Small one: the tests for the `invoiceline.go` mappers live in `invoiceline_test.go`. Could you move this test there?

Full details: Title check

**Explanation** The title names the main change: the invoice line mapper now places subscription and item IDs in the documented API fields. The raw summary and PR objectives both confirm the swap fix in mapSubscriptionReferencesToAPI, so the title matches the changeset. It is specific and uses the conventional fix(billing) prefix.
Full details: Linked Issues check

**Explanation** [`#5454`] The whole-PR diff against the merge base changes one mapper in `openmeter/billing/httpdriver/invoiceline.go`. `mapSubscriptionReferencesToAPI` now sets `Item.Id` from `optSub.ItemID` and `Subscription.Id` from `optSub.SubscriptionID`. Before the change these two sources were swapped, which matches the reported bug. The `Phase.Id` mapping is unchanged. The new test `TestMapSubscriptionReferencesToAPIKeepsIdsOnDocumentedFields` in `invoiceline_test.go` asserts `Subscription.Id`, `Phase.Id`, `Item.Id`, the billing period bounds, and that a nil input returns nil. The test file already imports `time`, `require`, and `timeutil`, so the new test has the imports it needs. The mapper is shared by standard and gathering invoice lines, so the fix covers both paths named in the issue. I did not run the test. The result rests on the diff and the file contents at the reviewed head. The previous PASS conclusion still holds for the same reason, and the diff since the previous head does not change it.
Full details: Out of Scope Changes check

**Explanation** [`#5454`] The whole-PR diff touches only two files: the mapper in `invoiceline.go` (+2/-2) and the new test in `invoiceline_test.go` (+23). The mapper change is the direct fix for the swapped `subscription.subscription.id` and `subscription.item.id` fields. The test covers that fix and the unchanged phase and billing-period mapping. No unrelated code, refactoring, or documentation changes appear in the reviewed diff.
